product_overview: The FERZ Consulting Website is designed to establish FERZ as the authoritative leader in deterministic AI governance. It provides clear, detailed information on FERZ’s patented AI governance products, services, methodologies, and intellectual property portfolio while facilitating lead generation and investor interest via optimized contact forms and resource downloads. The platform emphasizes technical excellence, SEO, accessibility, and fast performance.
core_goals: Build credibility and trust with enterprise decision makers such as CIOs, CISOs, CROs, and compliance leaders.
Clearly present FERZ’s patent-protected AI governance products, services, and methodologies with technical depth and business value.
Drive investor interest through clear exposition of FERZ’s intellectual property portfolio and licensing opportunities.
Enable effective lead capture via multiple optimized, secure contact forms integrated with serverless email submission.
Deliver a high-performance website that achieves top scores in SEO, accessibility, and responsiveness.
Implement robust SEO practices including server-side rendering, structured data, and social metadata for maximum online visibility.
Ensure the website is fully accessible and responsive across devices, following all relevant standards.
Provide easy-to-manage content systems for articles/blog posts with dynamic SEO metadata and markdown support.
Maintain clear, user-friendly navigation including a vertical mega-menu for all key content areas.
key_features: Comprehensive Core Pages: Homepage, detailed product pages, services overview, methodologies deep-dive, IP portfolio, articles/blog, and essential legal pages (About, Contact, Privacy, Disclaimer).
Multiple Secure Contact Forms: 4-5 forms scattered site-wide submitting securely via Resend API to FERZ team emails with staging and production environment safety.
Dynamic Articles System: Supports adding new posts with title, slug, content, images, and auto-generates SEO metadata, OpenGraph, Twitter cards, and schema for social sharing.
Vertical Mega-Menu Navigation: Fully responsive menu for Products, Services, Methodologies, Resources, and IP Portfolio navigation separation.

SEO and Performance Optimization: Server-side rendering via vite-plugin-ssr, JSON-LD structured data on all pages, optimized images and fonts, lazy loading, and aggressive tree shaking to achieve 90+ Lighthouse scores.
Accessibility Compliance: Semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, ARIA labeling, and WCAG contrast standards adherence.
PDF Library for resources downloads and intellectual property collateral.
Reusable UI and Page Templates supporting consistent branding and design.
Background animated visual effects enhancing user engagement and branding without compromising performance.
Staging authentication system to protect non-production environments.
user_flow_summary: User lands on homepage and immediately understands FERZ’s positioning, products, services, and methodologies via hero sections and clear navigation.
User explores products and services pages detailing problems solved, mathematical guarantees, and FERZ’s unique intellectual property and technology.
User browses methodologies pages for deep technical insights into frameworks like SCM, AI Capsule, and MRCF.
User reads thought leadership articles with dynamically loaded metadata optimized for search engines and social sharing.
User submits inquiries through multiple secure contact forms; on submission, user sees confirmation and FERZ’s team receives email via Resend API.
Users can download product documentation and other resources from a PDF library section.
Site navigation adapts fluidly across devices via vertical mega-menu and responsive design.
SEO structured data and metadata are server-rendered so search engines index complete, accurate information.
The entire site loads fast and supports WCAG-compliant accessibility features including keyboard navigation and screen reader compatibility.
validation_criteria: All pages are fully indexable and pass Google Rich Results Test with correct structured data.
Lighthouse scores for Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO meet or exceed 90 on all audited pages.
SEO metadata such as title, description, canonical URL, OpenGraph, Twitter cards, and JSON-LD structured data are auto-generated and validate cleanly.
Contact forms successfully submit data securely using the Resend API with delivery to configured FERZ team emails in both staging and production environments.
Site navigation is fully responsive and accessible on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices with no usability regressions.
Accessibility standards (WCAG) for color contrast, keyboard navigation, ARIA labelling, and semantic HTML are met consistently.
Page load times are under 2 seconds on 4G mobile connections with lazy loading for images and optimized fonts.
PDF resources are downloadable and correctly linked within the PDF Library section.
No critical or high-severity ESLint issues present; code follows provided styling and configuration rules.
All legal pages (Privacy Policy, Disclaimer, Terms) are present and compliant with FERZ’s requirements.
